about: When the models a recording uses stop working, and the request fields newer models stop accepting, as each provider's own pages said on the day in version. Only dates a page states are kept, each row with the page it comes from; nothing is fetched at runtime, and a newer release ships a newer table. Models that hold no conversation (embeddings, images, speech, video) and the Live APIs are left out.

anthropic.name: the Claude API
anthropic.keeps: Deprecated and retired models with their retirement dates and the replacements the page recommends; "not sooner than" dates for active models set no date and are left out. The extended thinking page says which models refuse a manual thinking budget.

openai.name: the OpenAI API
openai.keeps: Every chat, text and computer use model the page retires, with its shutdown date and the replacement it recommends; snapshots, with the aliases the page names beside them, and where a row names a model by its name with its snapshots (GPT-4o), that model's alias (gpt-4o) as well, with the row's words in named. The Chat Completions reference says o-series models don't take max_tokens.

gemini.name: the Gemini API
gemini.keeps: Gemini 3, 2.5 and 2.0 shutdown dates, which the page gives as the earliest a model may shut down (earliest: true).

vertex.name: Vertex AI
vertex.keeps: Gemini models with a set retirement date (an "or later" date sets none) and retired ones, from the model versions page; Claude and Jamba models with their shutdown dates, from the partner models page.

bedrock.name: Amazon Bedrock
bedrock.keeps: Text models launched before September 7, 2026 with an end-of-life date, by the Regions each date covers; models launched since then carry their dates on their model cards.

models.replacement: The most capable cyber model available to you.

fields.appliesTo: Claude 4.7 and later models, and Claude Mythos Preview
fields.behavior: Returns a 400 error when set to a non-default value
fields.says: a non-default temperature, top_p or top_k returns a 400 error
fields.instead: Omit and use prompting to guide model behavior

fields.behavior: This value is now deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens, and is not compatible with o-series models
fields.says: max_tokens is deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens and is not compatible with o-series models
fields.instead: Send the same limit as max_completion_tokens

fields.behavior: Claude 4.7 and later models do not support it and reject requests that use it, returning a 400 error
fields.says: extended thinking (thinking.type "enabled", with budget_tokens) is not supported and a request that uses it returns a 400 error
fields.instead: Remove budget_tokens, set thinking: {type: "adaptive"}, and control reasoning depth with output_config: {effort: ...} instead of a token budget
